extension.summary: Populate missing metadata and artwork for existing library items.
extension.description: Library Updatarr scans your existing Kodi video library for movies, TV shows, and episodes with missing posters, fanart, or metadata. It applies local artwork and NFO files first, then uses your installed online scrapers to fill remaining gaps — without wiping the database or scanning for new files.

extension.summary: One thin waveform line, made for the Aeon Fuse Now playing card (Linux ARM64)
extension.description: Build for Linux ARM64 (64-bit ARM, OpenGL ES): CoreELEC / LibreELEC 64-bit, Raspberry Pi 4 and 5. Aeon Fuse Waveform Visualizer is the Waveform visualisation of Kodi (by MrC and Team Kodi, visualization.waveform 22.1.1) changed for the Aeon Fuse skin: it draws one channel (left or right), both mixed, both overlaid, or both as two lines (as Waveform does), as a line through the middle of its box, of the same thin width on flat and steep strokes. Each point is the average of the audio it covers, smoothed with its neighbours and the frame before, and drawn as a smooth curve, so the line stays calm. How much is set by Smoothness, 0 (the raw samples, as Waveform) to 10 (calmest). Settings: channels, smoothness, points per line, height, smooth curve, line thickness, colours. Install the build for your device: the same add-on is published for Linux ARM64, Linux ARM 32-bit, Linux x86-64 and Windows x64.

extension.summary: Selects a preferred audio track when playback starts
extension.description: Audio Enforcer selects the first available audio track from up to five choices when a video starts. A choice can be the original language, the file's default track, Kodi's audio language, or a specific language. The original language comes from the file, and from TheMovieDB Helper when the file does not say. Commentary tracks can be skipped. Trailers, extras, and individual shows or movies can each use their own choice.
extension.news: Version 1.0.0 selects a preferred audio track when playback starts, including the original language, the file default, and a language for one show.

extension.summary: Automatically update and assign Kodi Video Versions from NFO files and filenames directly in the database.
extension.description: Kodi v21+ Video Versions does not yet import version names from NFO files or filenames during library scans. Video Versions Updatarr fills this gap by reading <videoassettitle>, <edition> NFO tags, or filename edition patterns, automatically adding custom version types and updating the videoversion database table. Supports both SQLite and MariaDB/MySQL with automatic configuration detection and a minimum 3-backup retention with easy restore.

extension.summary: Refresh library ratings by media type
extension.description: Refresh scraped ratings for movies, TV shows, episodes, or all of those types. IMDb scores come from IMDb's non-commercial dataset files. TMDb is the main online source, and a score already cached by TMDbHelper is reused. OMDb adds Rotten Tomatoes critic and Metacritic scores. MDbList can supply IMDb, TMDb, Trakt, Rotten Tomatoes critic and audience, Metacritic, Letterboxd, and MyAnimeList scores in one call. Trakt adds a public Trakt score. Requests stay inside the limits published by those services. Personal star ratings are left alone. This product uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.

extension.summary: Selects a preferred subtitle when playback starts, and can seek back so subtitles appear
extension.description: Subtitle Enforcer turns on the first available subtitle from up to five languages, in the order you set. A priority can be Original language, Default language, a listed language, Kodi's own subtitle language, or any language name or code. Original language follows the film, even when the audio is a dub, and TMDB wins if it disagrees with the file or the library. Default language uses the audio language the file marks as default. Leave the TMDB API key empty to use TMDBHelper's key. Each language can include hearing impaired (HI), SDH, and forced tracks, and the choice can follow whether you understand the audio. Trailers, extras, and individual shows can be skipped or given their own rule. It can also wait a few seconds after playback starts and seek backward, which makes Kodi show embedded subtitles that otherwise stay hidden until a manual seek.
extension.news: Version 2.4.0 gives a show or movie its own subtitle language, including the title that is playing.

extension.summary: Skippy: skip, mark, and edit video segments (intros, recaps, credits, and more) using local or online data.
extension.description: All-in-one Kodi companion for chapter-style workflows: automatically skip or prompt on segments, mark new ranges during playback, and open a full segment editor for .edl and Matroska-style chapters.xml sidecars. Configurable segment types (skip mode, aliases, EDL numbers), dialogs, and optional online lookups (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate keymaps for marker (skippy_marker.xml) and editor (skippy_editor.xml). Optional next episode prompt: offers the next episode (or the next movie of a collection) near the end, can start it automatically, and asks "Still watching?" after several episodes in a row.

Konfigurerbare segmenttyper (springtilstand, aliasser, EDL-numre), dialoger og valgfri onlineopslag (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate tastaturtilknytninger til markør (skippy_marker.xml) og editor (skippy_editor.xml). Valgfri prompt for næste afsnit: tilbyder næste afsnit (eller næste film i en samling) nær slutningen, kan starte det automatisk og spørger "Ser du stadig med?" efter flere afsnit i træk.

extension.summary: Library counts for the Aeon Fuse skin.
extension.description: Also publishes every rating (IMDb, TMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Trakt) of the focused item as Home properties (aeon.r.*), because Kodi lists only carry the default rating. Reads the size of the video and music libraries through JSON-RPC and publishes it as Home window properties (aeon.count.movies, aeon.count.tvshows, aeon.count.episodes, aeon.count.artists, aeon.count.albums, aeon.count.songs) for the Aeon Fuse skin. It refreshes on start-up and after every library scan or clean. It does nothing under other skins.

extension.summary: Shows Jellyfin trickplay seek thumbnails during video scrubbing.
extension.description: Reads or generates Jellyfin trickplay sprite tiles alongside your media, crops preview frames with Pillow while you scrub, and shows them via skin window properties. Optional ffmpeg generator writes .trickplay sidecars; use Install preview tools for Pillow (preview) and ffmpeg (generation). Use Show addon status / Install skin snippet in settings (DialogSeekBar.xml for most skins; VideoFullScreen.xml for Bello). Generation/HDR requires ffmpeg, ffprobe, and optionally dovi_tool.
